name: learn-kit
description: Pedagogical kit for learnable knowledge artifacts. Single skill `three-views` (v3.0.0 consolidates the prior 5 skills): given a topic and source material (project files / external URL / pasted text), generates 3-tier learning markdown (foundation 零基础版 / structural 结构版 / challenge 挑战版); then optionally renders interactive HTML (dual-mode grounding: repo-code via Explore subagent for concept→file:line; or source-evidence for URL/text sources) and/or pushes to NotebookLM for multimedia artifacts (audio + video + slide_deck × 3 views = 9 view-cycled + 1 shared mind_map = max 10 artifacts; quota right-sizing gate + bounded polling + 4-way re-run guard + per-step auth refresh preserved from nlm-studio dogfood). NLM portion requires notebooklm-mcp MCP server (bundled via this plugin's .mcp.json) + one-time `nlm login`. v3.0.0 BREAKING: removed 4 skills (scaffold-learning / locate / scan / nlm-studio) and renamed generate-tier → three-views; infographic artifact type retired. Migrate `/learn-kit:generate-tier` → `/learn-kit:three-views`; `/learn-kit:nlm-studio` → `/learn-kit:three-views` Step 4 select NLM. See `[ADR]_LearnKit_Consolidation_To_Single_Skill` + Migration guide §6 for full v5.0.x → v6.0.0 walkthrough.
